examples.text: C'erano bei fiori sul banco della reception.
examples.en: There were beautiful flowers on the reception desk.

examples.text: Devi compilare una domanda di ricovero in ospedale alla reception.
examples.en: You have to fill out an application for admission to the hospital at the front desk.

examples.text: Alcune aziende, alla reception, hanno le guardie al posto dei segretari.
examples.en: Some companies have guards at the front desk instead of receptionists.

examples.text: C'erano dei bei fiori sul banco della reception.
examples.en: There were beautiful flowers on the reception desk.
